subject: Purchase activation runbook and next owners
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex D'Souza <alex.dsouza@sparrowhealth.com>, Linda Gomez <linda.gomez@enterpriseco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Purchase activation runbook and next owners

Hi Alex / Linda —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed runbook to get Sparrow Health from pilot approval to active production billing. I attached a short runbook (PDF) and an MPA checklist (Excel) that map the legal/security/finance milestones to owners and target dates.

Summary (high level):
- Legal review (commercial terms & SOW): 7–10 business days (owner: Ben Carter)
- Security assessment (SaaS questionnaire + evidence): 5–8 business days in parallel (owner: Lauren Bishop)
- Finance: payment instrument confirmation (PO vs corporate card) and internal routing: 3–7 business days after legal sign-off (owner: Alex / Linda)
- PO issuance / DocuSign signature: target within 2 business days of final approvals

Open questions we flagged on the call:
1) Preferred payment path: PO (corporate procurement) vs card / marketplace purchase (do you want us to prepare both flows?)
2) Any internal audit windows or blackout dates in December we should avoid?
3) Who owns the formal security questionnaire turnaround at Sparrow — procurement or infosec?

Next steps I propose:
- Ben to send a short commercial redline window & initial SOW language by EOD tomorrow (Dec 8).
- Lauren to share a list of required evidence and a readout of what we can pre-populate from our SOC2 artifacts (by Dec 9).
- Alex/Linda to confirm payment instrument preference and primary procurement contact (by Dec 10).
- Quick follow-up call on Dec 11 to confirm the mutual action plan and milestone dates (30 min).

Attachments: 20261207-runbook-purchase-activation.pdf (runbook, milestone table), mpa-checklist.xlsx (owner matrix)

If that aligns, I'll lock the Dec 11 slot. Thanks — looking forward to moving this over the finish line.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform
From: Alex D'Souza <alex.dsouza@sparrowhealth.com>

Cc: Linda Gomez <linda.gomez@enterpriseco.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Purchase activation runbook and next owners

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap and the runbook. Confirming receipt of the attachments. A few notes from procurement side after an internal sync:

- Payment preference: Sparrow typically prefers PO routed through our procurement system, but we do have a marketplace option that some business units use when timing is critical. Wed like to evaluate both paths in parallel and default to PO if timeline permits.
- Primary procurement contact for issuance will be me for this engagement; I will coordinate with our finance team for PO approval.
- Regarding security questionnaire: Lindawill be our primary contact for infosec evidence. She will own the questionnaire turnaround but may engage our vendor risk team for some artifacts.

Can Ben draft the minimal redline we can circulate internally? If we can get a short SOW + minimal redline, I can start routing for an internal PO request. Also confirm whether the DocuSign flow can be prepared in parallel with the procurement paperwork — that would help hit the earliest possible activation date.

Thanks — Alex

Alex — looping in from legal/commercial.

I reviewed the runbook and attached a two-page commercial redline summary (PDF) that highlights: indemnity tweaks, data protection language, and a short SOW appendix. For speed, I recommend the following path:

- We prepare a limited redline (focused on the three items above) and a short SOW appendix that captures deliverables and success criteria. That should be sufficient for Sparrow to start the PO approval route while we iterate on the full MPA document.
- DocuSign can be staged in parallel. We can send a commercial redline + SOW as a PDF earmarked for signature; procurement can attach the PO as an exhibit if you prefer.

Proposed internal owners and tentative dates (updated):
- Commercial redline & SOW draft: Ben Carter (Dec 8 EOD) — attachment: 20261207-commercial-redline.pdf
- Security evidence packet readiness: Lauren Bishop (Dec 9) — will include SOC2 summary, pen test summary, and an evidence checklist
- Procurement confirmation (payment instrument & PO number): Alex/Linda (Dec 10)
- DocuSign envelope prepared and ready to send after PO number or final signature routing confirmed: Jordan (Dec 11)

If Sparrow prefers to shortcut via marketplace purchase, please flag which platform (AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace / Azure Marketplace) so we can prepare SKU/pricing and the marketplace paperwork. That path typically reduces purchase time but can change invoicing rules.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20261207-commercial-redline.pdf
